meta.note: Editable default commercial tariffs for the Roof-to-Grid simulator. LES and OPPD figures are from published 2026 rate schedules (effective Jan 1, 2026). ComEd, MidAmerican and Evergy figures are planning estimates — verify against the current tariff book before quoting a customer. Energy rates are blended $/kWh; demand charges are $/kW-month. All values are editable in the app.

sources.LES: les.com/rates/business-rates — General Service-Demand (11/12), Large Light & Power (15/16/39), effective Jan 1, 2026
sources.OPPD: OPPD Rate Manual, Resolution No. 6743, effective Jan 1, 2026 — Rate 231 (small demand), Rate 230 (non-demand)
